method.name: multiformat_bounded_serial_anchors_v1
method.assumptions: Only the separate 1995 bonus-pack pool is calibrated, using five non-autograph /50-/5 tiers with odds denominators >=20. Black has 29 eligible cards: Messi NF-23 is excluded. Conditional on selected serial ceilings substantially reaching bonus packs. Main-pack base and retail Mini Diamonds do not reconcile within 3%; no main/Mania/Sapphire estimates published. Bonus and encased pools are independent, not treated as regular Hobby packs. Range is conditional sensitivity, not a confidence interval. All other rows are reviewed nominal serial limits.
